acceptance_criteria.criterion: {{#if a}}A{{else if b}}B{{else}}C{{/if}} resolves correctly for all truth-table combinations (a=true, b=true → A; a=false, b=true → B; a=false, b=false → C)
Multi-level chains ({{else if b}}…{{else if c}}…{{else if d}}…) resolve to the first truthy branch
{{else if}} with no final {{else}} removes the block when all branches are falsy
{{else if}} nested inside outer {{#if}}…{{else}}…{{/if}} blocks resolves correctly via the existing innermost-first loop
Mixed syntax (flat {{else if}} chains alongside traditional nested {{#if}} blocks in the same template) works correctly
Multiline content within each branch is preserved
All 236 existing tests pass without modification (regression)
No imports added to src/engine/conditionals.ts (zero-dependency engine invariant)

comments.note: src/engine/conditionals.ts: Extracted the duplicated `noNestedIf` regex fragment (String.raw`(?:(?!\{\{#if\b)[\s\S])*?`) to a module-level constant `NO_NESTED_IF`. A future edit to one copy that missed the other would silently produce different match-guard behaviour in the pre-processor vs the main resolver — a latent divergence bug. Extraction is a zero-behavioral-change DRY fix. All 326 tests pass after the change.

notes: Implementation uses a pre-processing strategy: resolveElseIf() rewrites {{else if}} chains into nested {{else}}{{#if}} blocks before the main resolution loop runs. This means no changes to the core resolveConditionals logic — the existing innermost-first algorithm handles everything transparently.
The transformation is iterative: one level of {{else if}} is unwrapped per pass, so a chain of depth N is fully normalized in N passes. The do-while loop terminates when the string stops changing.
